what: Real Chrome output of CSS text-transform: capitalize on 6,000 seeded random strings (seed 20261001, 1-10 characters) over letters from several scripts, digits, every word joiner Content Lab treats specially and its near misses (".", ":", U+FF1A, U+FE55), combining marks, invisible format characters, the zero-width space, CJK, emoji and punctuation.
